summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NE Famine/69)

data.turoyo: <...> Bu+məqamawo nuqlíwayna u+zadayḏan mi+adro hoool d̥fayḥi. Məd̥‿fayiḥi, edi bəḥḏo xāfto məlyówayno edi ono lruḥi, maxlówayno bi+koro, ha hawxa əzzənwa lar+rəḥye. <...>
data.translation: <...> In that manner we would transport our grain from the threshing floor until it (lit. ‘they’) cooled down. When they cooled down, then I’d fill it in one light one then by myself, I would empty it into the bin, just like so they would go to the mills. <...>

rationale: New I Infectum box; paired endpoint and subsequent Preterit Intransitive retain the aspect contrast.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 2.5/8)

data.translation: <...> Den Weizen kochten sie, bis er gar war. Dann ließen sie ihn abkühlen und kneteten ihn zusammen mit dem ǧaǧiq.

rationale: New III Infectum-wa box; cooling caused to a plural grain patient.

summary: All 14 occurrences checked. New separate boxes are I Infectum and III Infectum-wa; ordinary cooling remains sense1.

In the same MAC Famine/69 verse, dependent fayḥi contrasts with later fayiḥi. Finite feminine fayiḥo/fayḥo must not be reboxed solely because masculine adjectival fayiḥo has a similar spelling; supplied Part act. feminine is fayəḥto.
I heart-subject refreshment and III heart-object encouragement are recorded as related idiomatic phrases and an experiencer extension. Searches for fayəḥ lebi, mafəḥ and fāḥ found no duplicate idiom.
Cooling a leg and the edition's became healthy paraphrase do not independently establish a heal sense.
III physical cooling and spreading fragrance are already combined in inherited sense1. The corpus does not require renumbering existing examples to split them.
Confirm contracted fāḥ in MAC Habirman/2 and conventionality of the heart expression.
In JTM3.2/15, does həne refer to the encouraging situation, or is it the human subject/topic? The plural mafəḥiwa favors human actors but needs checking.
Confirm reduced fayḥo and its stress against audio if available; no audio evidence is supplied.
Do editors wish eventually to split III cooling from fragrance spreading? This run preserves inherited numbering.
Heart as experiencer subject yields emotional refreshment after food; a draining inflamed leg cools in PrS26/14, without proving a separate heal sense.
